what: The plugin, its settings and the logins surviving a Hermes update, with a real switch and a billing proof on the new build.
machine: Hyper-V test machine switcher-test, Windows 11 Pro 25H2 build 26200; Hermes installed by a normal signed-in user with the official source script
plugin: codex-account-switch 1.2.0-rc.4 development build (archive SHA-256 204fe9c071f3686ac1a0bb572fb2f4e5b63861eada941be8ec8c566b78a90a79), installed in profiles default and work before the update

refreshed the Windows gateway launcher scripts
